# R3.5 — Tool-exposure residual (BL-16 / DF-S1.17-1 + ADR-0272)

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/141_R3.5__tool-exposure-residual.md`
(seq 5 of 11, Round 3, manifest row 141). **Requirement ids:**
`DF-S1.17-1`, `BL-16`, `ADR-0272`; `R-2.5.2`, `R-2.5.3`, `R-2.5.4`;
ADR-0357 (new). **Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-r3.4` — the stacked
R3.4 tip (operator merges; mergePolicy: OPERATOR). **Layer:**
fixture-verified — offline/hermetic only; no staging/live claims, no
credentials, no production mutations.

## What

Discharges **DF-S1.17-1**'s two residual members; closes **BL-16**;
re-verdicts **R-2.5.3** `PARTIAL → MET`; fires-answers **ADR-0272**'s
revisit legs (a) and (b) with dated evidence; (c)/(d) re-checked
fired-answered at the same sweep — the trigger is fully discharged and
ADR-0272 re-homes to BL-43.

**1. `provider_tool_api` deferral flags on both minimal profiles.**
`minimal-patch`/`minimal-string-replace` declare
`deferred_tools`/`tool_search` = `unknown` on `ProfileCapabilities` —
the fail-closed C0 spelling of unsupported, never a guessed `declared`;
the codec round-trips both members.

**2. The provider artefact carries the flags + the loss gate.**
`lower_provider` emits `deferral{deferred_tools, tool_search}` verbatim
and per-tool `deferrable`; a deferred-admitting surface under an
unestablished `deferred_tools` records a declared `no_slot`/`narrowed`
loss — never a silent direct-only narrowing. Declared capability →
clean leg, no loss.

**3. `surface_rejection_rate` computes in the one fold (CC1;
AC-R-2.5.2-12).** `surface_rejected ÷ model-emitted calls` deduped on
the `tool_call` scope; strata `{profile}|{family}` — profile joins
`model.call.requested{profile_ref | model_ref.profile_ref}`, family
reads the payload member the emitters stamp from `binding.family_id`;
`unknown` absent, `n/a{estimator_undefined}` on empty denominators,
`n/a{class}` for hosted. The declaration's `fold` flipped
`N(Capability) → C`.

**4. `family` end-to-end.** `action.tool.proposed` /
`surface_rejected` payloads gain the optional `family` member; the env
dispatcher stamps the binding's `family_id`; `SurfaceSpec.family`
carries it through the driver's proposal mint, the guard's parser-reject
row, and the `leaf.arm` round-trip; `None`/`null` stays honest on
host-cap and unshaped surfaces — never guessed.

**5. ADR-0272 leg (a).** `sync_source` computes the `CatalogDelta` off
a fixture listing (one drop + one lift) and runs the existing `adopt`
leg end-to-end — epoch +1, removed surface out, lifted surface in at
`authority = unverified`, source row refreshed, both
`action.tool.catalog.*` rows emitted. Removing the adopt leg fails the
new regression leg.

**6. ADR-0272 leg (b).** `retrieval_eval` over `benchset.stage3.v1`
(≥200-entry catalogue, 46 labelled queries / 23 tasks): `exact_name`
recall@8 = nDCG@8 = **1.0000** (the gated floor re-verified); `bm25`
and `hierarchical` meet the floor on the *same* exact-name set — **no
underperformance, the floor's scope stands**; NL / path / regex arms
record 1.0000/1.0000. Baselines pinned in the battery.
